protocol.status: Retained for research at user request; none was previously accepted as a universal strategy.

single_assets.SPY: US large-cap equity; overlap with earlier technology constituents

protocol.universe_rationale: Predetermined exposures across equity size, geography, non-technology sectors, gold and bonds plus six non-tech large-cap stocks. No asset substitution or exclusion based on strategy results. Current surviving listings imply selection/survivorship bias.
protocol.market_data: Fresh Yahoo chart daily adjusted OHLC and raw JSON, dividends/splits if supplied. Download error is a coverage issue, never a silent strategy pass. Quote validation and deterministic common-date alignment required.
protocol.audit_only_download: QQQ, to compare historical snapshots with previous cached data; never counted as a new held-out asset.
protocol.end_rule: If sources have shorter history than intended end, use the latest common available date across all successfully validated downloads and disclose the actual cutoff. No invented future quotes.
protocol.required_checks: All 18 singles and 4 frozen baskets: primary, full available history, 2014-2019, 2020 onward; frozen initial state freshly reset for each run.
protocol.secondary_checks: Primary/full: 20bp fee and extra one-session signal delay; all eligible annual January starts 2000-2021 with complete five-year windows. These diagnostics do not retune candidates.
protocol.prospective_probe: If data newer than 2026-09-04 exist, carry the primary portfolio state forward without resetting. Report this short new-time segment separately; do not claim statistical validation.
protocol.accounting: Same frozen v2 engine, monthly previous-close signals to next available opening quote; capital10000, one-wayfee5bp, cashyield0, no strategy debt/short, adjusted-index fractional units, dividend reinvestment implicit, taxes0. Equal-return fixed leverage resets monthly, 5.3% annual interest when borrowing, 0x-3x search, lowest solvent root. Daily close maximum drawdown.
protocol.decision: Per asset and universal status reported separately. Any worse drawdown rejects universal qualification; unmatched equal-return benchmarks are unresolved. No passing percentage threshold selected after seeing results.
protocol.out_of_sample_scope: Assets not used in this conversation's previous candidate construction. This is held-out asset validation, not necessarily statistically independent of training assets, and not a long untouched temporal sample. No selection of a winning asset subset for a universal-performance claim.
